canonicalTrail.type: closed ring split into eight official linear stages

sectionCoverage.distancePolicy: Use official section-page display distances where straightforward. For Etapp 5, display about 19 km and preserve Naturkartan 21.4 km as a duplicate-geometry artifact note; keep computed GPX lengths as geometry metadata.

geometryPlan.reusePolicy: Use normalization-plan.research.json as the detailed geometry plan. Do not duplicate the full per-section transform list in this handoff.
summary: Implement geometry transforms in a staging script or notebook under candidate research first; do not write public/data, public/routes or data/source/hiking until the user explicitly requests runtime integration.
For each normalized section, preserve raw source URL, transform instructions, computed length, official display distance, endpoint gap notes and route-page marker caveats.
Before runtime import, run a map visual review of every repaired multi-track section against the official PDF/map viewer and adjacent section endpoints.
Do not silently drop route-piece joins; store join distances in metadata where they exceed normal GPS jitter.
highLevelRepairs: Etapp 1 uses track 1 followed by reversed track 2, with the official GPX endpoint retained for continuity and Nynäs/Nynässtugan kept as stage-goal facility/access metadata.
Etapp 3, Etapp 4, Etapp 5 and Etapp 8 require documented sequencing, reversal and/or duplicate-piece repair from normalization-plan.research.json.
Etapp 6 must be reversed to official Stjärneberg-to-Lilla Laxemar direction.
Etapp 7 can use official GPX unchanged in stored Lilla Laxemar-to-Hällveberg direction.
Etapp 8 closes the digital ring using official GPX endpoint; Lilla Hycklinge cabin marker remains endpoint facility/access metadata pending a separately sourced access leg.
unknowns: unknown/recheck: final visual QA against official PDF/map viewer for repaired multi-track sections before runtime import.
unknown/recheck: whether a separately sourced access leg should be added from Etapp 8 official GPX end to Lilla Hycklinge cabin.

sourcePolicy: Import as candidate facilities only where normalization-plan.research.json says records are high-confidence and source-backed.
Cabin-yard wells, taps, toilets, fireplaces, grills and woodsheds where no separate source-backed coordinate exists should remain facility metadata or clustered subfacilities.

Access/service clusters such as Närtrafik, taxi/pickup dependencies, Figeholm, Fårbo, Klintemåla, Stensjö by service, Tilias and other food/lodging/shop/marina clusters should remain access or service metadata unless route-adjacent and source-backed.
importAsCandidateFacilities: Official endpoint cabin clusters: Nynäs, Lönhult, Krokstorp, Mörtfors, Stjärneberg, Lilla Laxemar, Hällveberg, Lilla Hycklinge.
High-confidence official access/parking/toilet records already present in section files, subject to duplicate resolution.
High-confidence official POIs such as Snäckedal and Stensjö by, preserving access restrictions.
pendingOrSuppress: Protected-area or water-protection context not confirmed by GIS overlay.
dedupeKeysToReview: Shared endpoint cabins between adjacent stages.
Mörtfors toilets/parking records shared between Etapp 4 and Etapp 5.
Krokstorp cabin/toilet/well records shared between Etapp 3 and Etapp 4.
Lilla Laxemar records shared between Etapp 6 and Etapp 7.
Hällveberg records shared between Etapp 7 and Etapp 8.
unknowns: unknown/recheck: publication-time cabin availability, fees, water reliability, water quality and exact subfacility coordinates where section files mark them pending.

staticRulePolicy: Official reserve/cultural-reserve rules where the source says the route passes through the area, such as Humlenäs and Stensjö by.
Cabin-specific no-outdoor-fire/no-electricity/boil-water wording from current official cabin pages, with accessed dates.
completedGisOverlays: Hummeln/Kristdala, Eckern/Djupeträsk, Fårbo, Bockara and Älvehult water-protection areas
unknowns: unknown/recheck: current KLT/Närtrafik, fire-risk, hunting, forestry and cabin/water status at publication time.

blockers.details: Ready for normalization planning, not runtime import.
Research-only candidate GeoJSON exists for all eight Naturkartan GPX section sources; runtime import still needs an explicit import task and visual QA.
Boundary-sensitive protected-area, Natura 2000, water-protection and biotopskydd checks are recorded in normalized-candidate/protected-area-overlays.research.json.
Cabin availability/fees, water reliability/quality, KLT/Närtrafik, fire risk, hunting signs/notices, forestry and route passability are publication-time checks.

openDecisionsForUser.decision: Decide whether runtime import should include a separately sourced access leg from Etapp 8 official GPX end to the Lilla Hycklinge cabin, or keep the 156.4 m gap as metadata only.
openDecisionsForUser.whyItMatters: The normalization plan keeps the official GPX endpoint to close the digital ring and treats the cabin marker as endpoint facility/access metadata unless a sourced access leg is approved.

openDecisionsForUser.decision: Decide whether optional narrative POIs and approximate swim/access points should be included in the first runtime import or left pending.
openDecisionsForUser.whyItMatters: Many are useful but lack exact coordinates or require side-service/access modeling.

openDecisionsForUser.decision: Approve candidate-only geometry normalization prototype before any shared runtime source data is touched.
openDecisionsForUser.whyItMatters: The existing plan explicitly says to prototype and QA under candidate research first.

validationChecklist: JSON parse this handoff and every changed research file.
Confirm normalization-plan.research.json remains the controlling detailed plan.
Verify all 8 section files exist and match sectionCoverage.sectionIds.
Implement candidate-only geometry transforms with raw source URL, transform instruction, computed length, display distance and endpoint gap metadata.
Run visual QA against official PDF/map viewer for repaired multi-track sections.
Confirm Etapp 8 closes the digital ring at the official GPX endpoint and does not silently snap to Lilla Hycklinge cabin.
Review duplicate endpoint cabin/toilet/well/parking records before import rows.
Review normalized-candidate/protected-area-overlays.research.json before static rule import and repeat overlays if route geometry or source boundaries change.
Recheck fire bans, KLT/Närtrafik, cabin availability/fees, water, hunting signs/notices and forestry/passability before runtime publication.
Keep all outputs research-only until the user explicitly requests runtime integration.

notes: This handoff intentionally reuses normalization-plan.research.json rather than duplicating every repair instruction.

All eight sections are researched and static caveats now have a controlling policy or generated candidate overlay, but runtime import still needs an explicit import task, visual geometry QA, duplicate facility resolution and publication-time checks for unstable facts.
